Smartrun Power Bank With Diary | Metal Pen | 10000mAH Power Capacity

The Smartrun Power Bank With Diary is a premium multi-utility corporate gifting product designed for modern professionals, executives, and business travelers. Combining smart technology with elegant stationery, this product offers a 10000mAH power bank, a stylish diary organizer, a durable and essential accessories—all in one compact design. It is an ideal choice for corporate gifts, promotional giveaways, and executive welcome kits.

Crafted for performance and presentation, the features a high-capacity lithium battery that supports Input DC 5V 2A and Output DC 5V 2A, ensuring fast and safe charging for multiple devices. Compatible with iOS, Android, and Type-C devices, this smart organizer keeps professionals powered throughout the day.

Premium Design with Smart Utility

This premium organizer comes with a metal flap closure that adds a professional and sophisticated look. Inside, it includes a dedicated cash and card pocket, allowing users to store essentials securely. The built-in pen loop ensures easy access during meetings, conferences, or travel.

The integrated 16GB pendrive adds extra functionality, making the a complete productivity companion. Users can store presentations, documents, and media files while charging their devices on the go.

The powerful 10000mAH is suitable for charging smartphones, wireless earbuds, smartwatches, and other USB-powered devices. With stable 5V 2A output, it ensures efficient charging without overheating or power fluctuation. This makes it a reliable solution for daily office use, travel, and outdoor business events.

Multiple cable compatibility including iOS cable, Android cable, and Type-C cable eliminates the need to carry extra chargers. Everything is neatly organized inside the for maximum convenience.

Ideal for Corporate & Promotional Gifting

The is widely used as a corporate gift, employee joining kit item, conference giveaway, and brand promotion product. Its premium appeal and practical usage make it a high-value gifting option that enhances brand recall.

The product supports custom logo branding on the cover, metal pen, and packaging, making it perfect for companies looking to promote their brand professionally. Whether for festive gifting, client appreciation, or corporate events, this product delivers lasting impressions.

  • Battery Capacity: 10000mAH

  • Compatible Devices: iOS, Android & Type-C
  • Accessories Included: Metal Pen, Pen Loop
  • Storage: Cash & Card Pocket

  • USB Storage: 16GB Pendrive
  • Usage: Corporate Gifts, Promotional Items, Executive Kits
Why Choose?

Unlike regular notebooks or power banks, the offers a complete all-in-one solution. It enhances productivity, ensures device charging, stores important data, and presents a professional image. Its premium materials, smart layout, and multi-functional design make it one of the most preferred corporate gifting products in India. If you are looking for a high-quality branded power bank diary that delivers both utility and style, the is the perfect choice for your business needs.
